description: Scans automotive C/C++ source for MISRA C 2012 and AUTOSAR C++14 coding-standard violations using deterministic pattern detection. Returns severity-ranked findings with line numbers and matching snippets, suitable for safety-critical (ASIL-B/D) review.

code.description: Source code to scan. Both C and C++ are supported. Comments and string literals are stripped before regex matching.

file_path.description: Original file path used for context and to switch on language-specific rules (e.g. AUTOSAR-A5-2-2 only fires for .cpp/.hpp).

findings.description: All rule violations detected, sorted by line then rule id.

rule.description: Rule id, e.g. MISRA-21.6 or AUTOSAR-A5-2-2

loc.description: Lines of code in the input (including blanks).
